podcast.title: Anne Bogan's Membership
podcast.body: Anne Bogan, a versatile singer who later joined The Marvelettes, had previously sung with The Andantes, indicating her established role within Motown's session musician community. "Anne was a sort of general utility singer around Motown. She'd sung with the Andantes and the Changes 3"

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 93: "Please Mr. Postman" by the Marvelettes

podcast.title: Motown's In-House Backing Vocal Group
podcast.body: The Andantes served as Motown's prominent in-house backing vocalists, contributing to numerous recordings. They sang backing vocals on The Marvelettes' single "The Darnells" and frequently provided backing for later Marvelettes records when the main group was on tour. "Motown's in-house backing vocal group The Andantees."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 93: "Please Mr. Postman" by the Marvelettes

podcast.title: Motown's Normal Female Backing Group
podcast.body: The Andantes were Motown's regular female backing vocal group. Their unavailability for one session led Martha Reeves to call The Delphiys to fill in, which eventually led to The Delphiys being signed as Martha and the Van Dellers. "for one session, the Andantes, Motown's normal female backing vocal group, were unavailable."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
